meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: 网页开发工程师与运营专员在需要自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器时必用！通过 CDP 协议无缝接管当前浏览器，自动配置环境并实时可视化执行任务。完美保留登录状态，一键完成复杂网页自动化流程，让繁琐操作自动化。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接管当前 Chrome 自动完成网页操作，保留登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要在网页上重复执行操作且需要保留登录状态。
copy.tagline_en: Automate tedious web flows in an existing Chrome with login preserved.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely repeat manual steps in a browser and need to stay logged in.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先自动运行安装脚本备好 agent-browser 依赖,再通过 CDP(端口 9222)接管你正在用的 Chrome:打开网页、抓取可交互元素、填表点击,并把每一步截图给你看。
howto.when: 当你要自动化现有的 Chrome 浏览器(例如网页搜索、填表)时触发。技能要求先跑自动安装脚本,并用脚本启动保留登录状态的 Chrome,否则不做自动化。

say.text: 帮我在 Chrome 里打开小红书,搜索 labubu,然后截图给我看
say.note: 会在你的浏览器里打开并截图结果

say.text: 把这个表单页的字段填好并提交,把结果截图发我
say.note: 它先抓元素再填,再截图

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first runs an auto-install script for agent-browser, then takes over your Chrome via CDP (port 9222): open pages, snapshot interactive elements, fill fields and click, and screenshot each step for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to automate your existing Chrome, e.g. web search or form filling. The skill requires running the auto-install script and starting Chrome with a persistent profile first.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu in my Chrome, search labubu, and screenshot it
say_en.note: Opens in your browser and screenshots the result

say_en.text: Fill in the fields on this form page, submit, and screenshot it
say_en.note: It snapshots elements, fills, then screenshots

say_en.text: Run the chrome-automation auto-install script, then connect to my Chrome
say_en.note: Checks and installs deps before connecting
